segment_summary: বিশ্বাস ও প্রার্থনার সেই দীপশিখা, যা সমস্ত প্রতিকূলতা সত্ত্বেও নিভে যায়নি, তার স্থায়ীত্বের উদযাপন।

segment_enrichment.angle: Philosophical Shift: Moving beyond individual triumph to focus on how that personal victory retroactively exposes systemic flaws in social structures regarding womanhood.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: At the threshold of their shared sanctuary (লৌহবাসরঘরের বাইরে); Desire: To articulate in one word the totality of her endurance; Obstacle: The overwhelming weight of unsaid words and past sacrifices.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Re-reading the trials: Viewing every previous obstacle (divine wrath, societal gaze) through the lens of its necessity for this singular moment of apotheosis.
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The smell of rain on dry earth immediately following intense drought (symbolizing crisis breaking into fullness).
segment_enrichment.research_question: How can the transition from extreme internal suffering (Chapter 6) to external triumph (Chapter 15/63) be narrated while maintaining a consistent high-register diction?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: Circular argument: Structure each segment as a rhetorical counterpoint to the previous one—Thesis (Trial) -> Antithesis (Faith/Endurance) -> Synthesis (Reunion).
segment_enrichment.variety_note: This chapter pivots from intense internal struggle to external fulfillment; where neighbors dwelt in pressurized introspection, this segment emphasizes resonant proclamation and enduring spiritual aftermath, while incorporating a deliberate structural volta based on re-reading past experience through the lens of reunion.
